metadata.name: GetMerchantPaymentBatchDetails
metadata.description: Purpose of this API is to get the Payment Batch details.

children.name: MerchantPaymentBatchDetailList
children.description: MonetaryBatchDetail

children.name: BatchDate
children.description: Date of the batch. For new batches, current date automatically displays. Valid Values:0-9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY Example: 01/01/2020

children.name: BatchStatus
children.description: The current status of the batch. Valid values: 0- New 1- In Balance 2- Out of Balance 3- Needs Re-posting 4- Posted 5- Batch Flagged for Deletion 6- Summary 7- Batch Flagged for Error(s) 8- Rejected 9- Fraud 10- Processed 11- Non-Monetary Processed 12- Dispute Resolution Batch 16- Rejected: ACH Auto Return 17- Rejected: ACH Manual Return Allowable Values: 50

children.name: BatchDescription
children.description: A short description of the batch. Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Example: Merchant Payment Allowable Values: 100

children.name: NumberItems
children.description: Number of items in the batch  as input by user. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 10

children.name: CalculatedNumber
children.description: The number of items in the batch as calculated by the system. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 2

children.name: NumberDifference
children.description: The difference between the number of items the user entered and the number of items calculated by the system. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 2

children.name: BatchTotalDebits
children.description: Total amount of debits in the batch as input by the user. Valid Values:0-9 Example: 1000.00

children.name: CalculatedDebitAmount
children.description: The total amount of debits in the batch as calculated by the system. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXX.XX Example: 200.00

children.name: DebitDifference
children.description: The difference between the amount of debits the user entered and the amount of debits calculated by the system. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXX.XX Example: 200.00

children.name: BatchTotalCredits
children.description: Total amount of credits in the batch as input by the user. Valid Values:0-9 Example: 1000.00

children.name: CalculatedCreditAmount
children.description: The total amount of credits in the batch as calculated by the system Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXX.XX Example: 200.00

children.name: CreditDifference
children.description: The difference between the amount of credits the user entered and the amount of credits calculated by the system. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXX.XX Example: 200.00

children.name: MerchantID
children.description: Unique number of merchant account Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345

children.name: StoreID
children.description: Specific code assigned to a Store. Valid Values:XXX Format:0-9 Example:1234

children.name: RegisterID
children.description: Unique ID assigned to a Register. Valid Values: a-z 0-9 Format:  xxxxx Example:   123456 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: MerchantNumber
children.description: Number which is assigned to a Merchant. Valid Values- 0-9 Format:XXXXXX Example:11642 Allowable Values: 9

children.name: TransactionList
children.description: TransactionList

children.name: EffectiveDateTime
children.description: Posting time of Transaction to the batch. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example:  02/02/2020  20:20:20

children.name: AccountNumber
children.description: Card Number of account holder. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example: 8000000000000037 Allowable Values: 19

children.name: CardNumber
children.description: get or set DecryptedCardNumber

children.name: TransactionCode
children.description: Payment Transaction Code Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example: 86221 = AUTO ACH PAYMENT

children.name: PaymentSource
children.description: Source from which Payment is received for the inventory order. Valid Values: A-Z Example:ACH Allowable Values: 24

children.name: TransactionAmount
children.description: Amount of Transaction Valid Values:0-9 Format:  XXX.XX Example:  200.00

children.name: TransactionDescription
children.description: User defined description of transaction if entered by user explicitly. If not entered by the user, then system will generate it. Valid Values:A-Z,0-9 Format: xxxxxxxx Example:Purchase/Payment. Allowable Values: 100

children.name: MerchantID
children.description: Unique number of merchant account Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345

children.name: PostingReference
children.description: Posting reference (Like -Transaction Posted Successfully) Valid Values: A-Z 0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXX Example: Transaction Posted Successfully Allowable Values: 50

children.name: BatchTransactionID
children.description: Unique Id for transactions added to Batch. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 123456 Allowable Values: 20
